description: Data that pi-ai-openai migrated from the sealed Model packages. The sources are read-only; nothing imports them.

sources.migrated: the 12 models, the parameter subset (drops become unsupported), capabilities and limits, the 4194304-byte image limit and the endpoint evidence of 2026-09-28

effort sets, image rule per model, the six Pro models with unknown input scope, and the encrypted-item rule (format openai-responses-v1, data not empty and not [REDACTED]); the sealed method name `openai-complete-output-group-workload-estimated/1` (OPENAI_FAMILY_REPLAY, lines 18-20) and the whole-group condition of classifyOpenAiDetail (lines 299-333), which the meter sees as the units the codec wrote `reasoning_details` for
the o200k_base proxy encoding of the visible JSON, images as placeholders, no estimate for encrypted reasoning
the three patch rules and the detail fitting; data URL decoding, image-size and the single-frame GIF check are not migrated
the cache read and write deduction from the prompt and the unknown negative remainder; cost is not migrated
the function tool subset: the parameters schema is an object

the complete-output-group method: a whole unit that carries reasoning state is counted once as the upstream output tokens O of the call that produced it, O already including reasoning; the refusals when O is unknown, when reasoning exceeds output, or when the counting combination of the source differs. The private observation protocol, replaySelection and the caller-carried responses are not migrated: the numbers come from the dispatch records of the model runtime through the preparation lease

the complete envelope difference: the new units are counted as count(envelope + new units) - count(envelope + []) with the tools left out of the envelope, and added to the real input total of the continued call as an estimate

sealedRevisions.note: Every current record starts at revision 1. The sealed revisions and their frozen originals are not migrated: the digest of the new record format cannot equal a sealed adoption, so no sealed revision resolves exactly.
